content: {"rules": ["Model forecasts consistently overshoot true outcomes by 3-5% due to a structural upward bias in the EU ETS pricing algorithm.", "When sentiment history shows high positive values (0.67+), the model's upward forecast is significantly more accurate than during low sentiment periods.", "The model exhibits mean-reversion lag, predicting higher prices even when recent true outcomes show sharp declines.", "Forecasts fail to capture immediate volatility spikes, resulting in a systematic delay of 2-3 days before price direction aligns with reality.", "High sentiment combined with rising historical prices triggers excessive forecast overshoots that must be corrected downward by at least 4%.", "Low sentiment periods often precede the model's failure to predict sustained drops, requiring a manual override to reduce forecasted values.", "The model assumes linear growth but actual outcomes display chaotic oscillation, necessitating a volatility dampening factor in predictions."] }
